key_interactions.effect: Strong inhibitors double metoprolol levels and reduce its cardioselectivity (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor closely when the combination cannot be avoided.

key_interactions.effect: Additive bradycardia and slowed AV conduction (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor heart rate; with clonidine, withdraw the beta-blocker several days before tapering clonidine.
Observe for hypotension, bradycardia, vertigo or syncope.

key_interactions.effect: Patients with severe allergic reactions may not respond to usual epinephrine doses (label).
